sections.title: Gutter contractor serving Edinburg
paras: Edel Roofing is based in Edinburg and has installed and repaired roofing systems across Hidalgo County since 2003. Gutters are part of that same job, a roof that sheds water properly still needs somewhere for that water to go. We install seamless gutters and repair existing systems on homes and businesses throughout Edinburg.

Gutters that are clogged, sagging, or missing sections send water straight down the side of your house instead of away from it. Over time that damages siding, fascia boards, and the foundation. We inspect your gutters the same way we inspect a roof, find the actual problem, give you a straight answer, and fix it right.

sections.title: Gutter services we offer in Edinburg

cards.title: Seamless Gutter Installation
cards.body: Custom-fit seamless aluminum gutters formed on-site to match your roofline exactly, fewer joints means fewer leak points than sectional gutters.

cards.title: Gutter Repair
cards.body: Sagging sections, separated joints, and pulled-away hangers. We re-secure, reseal, or replace the damaged section, most repairs are a single visit.

cards.title: Downspout Installation & Repair
cards.body: Properly placed and sized downspouts move water away from your foundation instead of pooling next to it. We fix clogged, disconnected, or undersized downspouts.

cards.title: Gutter Guards
cards.body: Guards keep leaves and debris out of the gutter channel, which cuts down on clogs and how often you need to clean them, worth it if your property has nearby trees.

cards.title: Gutter Replacement
cards.body: When a gutter system is too damaged or outdated to repair, we remove the old sections and install a full new seamless system.

cards.title: Roof & Gutter Inspection
cards.body: Since we're already on the roof, we check the gutters at the same time, where water is pooling, where it's overflowing, and whether the pitch is still correct.

sections.title: Gutters in Edinburg: what we see most
paras: Edinburg gets hit with heavy, fast rain during storm season, the kind that overwhelms an undersized or clogged gutter system in minutes. Homes without gutters, or with gutters that have failed, tend to show it at the foundation first: erosion along the drip line, water intrusion at the slab edge, and staining on siding directly below the roofline.

Older neighborhoods near downtown Edinburg often still have the original sectional gutters from when the house was built, those joints are usually the first thing to fail. Newer construction around the north side more commonly needs downspout adjustments rather than a full replacement, since the gutters themselves are newer but sometimes undersized for how hard it rains here.
If you're already having roof work done, adding or replacing gutters at the same time means one crew, one visit, and no redoing trim or fascia work twice.

faqs.q: Do you install seamless gutters in Edinburg?
faqs.a: Yes. We form seamless aluminum gutters on-site to match your roofline, which means fewer joints and fewer places for leaks to start compared to gutters assembled from pre-cut sections.

faqs.q: How do I know if my gutters need repair or full replacement?
faqs.a: If the damage is limited to a section or two, a pulled hanger, a separated joint, a small leak, repair usually makes sense. If the system is old, sagging in multiple places, or was undersized to begin with, replacement is usually the better long-term fix. We give you a straight answer after inspecting it, not an upsell.

If your property has trees nearby, guards cut down significantly on how often the gutters clog and need cleaning. If there's little tree cover, the benefit is smaller. We can tell you what makes sense for your specific property during the estimate.

faqs.q: Can you do gutters at the same time as a roof replacement or repair?
faqs.a: Yes, and it's usually the most efficient way to handle it, one crew on-site, no redoing fascia or trim work twice, and the gutters go up right after the new roofline is set.

faqs.q: How do I get a gutter estimate in Edinburg?
faqs.a: Call us at (956) 422-3335 or book online. We'll come look at your roofline, take measurements, and give you a written estimate. Estimates are free and there's no obligation.
